o.text:
Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish چُوقْ (çoq), چوخ (çoḫ), from Proto-Turkic *čok (“many, very; to gather, multiply”).
Cognate with Turkish çok, Gagauz çok, Crimean Tatar çoq, etc.
Borrowed from Classical Persian اهل فساد (ahl-i fasād).
Borrowed from Russian сноуборд (snoubord), from English snowboard.
